claim.text: The proposed benchmark is the only entry in the comparison table that combines automated task generation, fine-grained difficulty analysis, and coverage of all seven perturbation dimensions.
claim.scope: Judge only from the supplied evidence pack.

evidence_pack.text: Benchmark comparison, prior benchmark A: automated generation = no; fine-grained analysis = no; perturbation dimensions covered = layout.
Prior benchmark B: automated generation = no; fine-grained analysis = no; dimensions covered = layout, background, robot initial state, language.
Prior benchmark C: automated generation = no; fine-grained analysis = no; dimensions covered = layout, language.
Prior benchmark D: automated generation = no; fine-grained analysis = no; dimensions covered = layout.
Prior benchmark E: automated generation = yes; fine-grained analysis = no; dimensions covered = layout, light, camera viewpoint, language.
Prior benchmark F: automated generation = yes; fine-grained analysis = no; dimensions covered = layout, background, light, camera viewpoint.
The proposed benchmark: automated generation = yes; fine-grained analysis = yes; dimensions covered = layout, background, light, camera viewpoint, robot initial state, language, sensor noise.

gold.private_rationale: Все семь строк таблицы сравнения в паке. Автоматическую генерацию имеют только E, F и предлагаемый бенчмарк; fine-grained-анализ — только предлагаемый; все семь измерений — тоже только он. Совмещение трёх свойств действительно уникально, и это видно из пака без внешних знаний.

gold.private_rationale: Модели, стартующие около 95 (B 97.1, C 95.3, D 97.6, I 95.2, J 97.5), в агрегате дают 69.6, 55.8, 67.9, 42.9 и 68.4 — все выше 30. claim.text: The negative compositionality gaps between pairs of perturbations are statistically significant.
claim.scope: Judge only from the supplied evidence pack.

evidence_pack.text: Pairwise perturbation heatmap: the fifteen reported compositionality gaps are -0.35, -0.48, -0.54, -0.64, -0.68, -0.70, -0.77, -0.81, -0.86, -0.90, -0.99, -1.12, -1.22, -1.26 and -1.62.
30,000 independent repeated trials were run, with 2,000 trials per dimension combination.
Statistical significance of the results is verified with a chi-squared test reported in Appendix F.

gold.private_rationale: Все пятнадцать разрывов действительно отрицательны, это пак подтверждает. Но знак — не значимость: заявленная значимость опирается на χ²-тест, результатов которого в паке нет. Судить о claim нельзя.
